scope: In-game display names for the 63 site weapons, linked from Frosty internal names through game UI metadata and the English localization string table. Replaces hand-transcribed site spellings.
method: FrostyCmd export-strings bf6 <game> Common/Localization/Languages/fs_us_loc: 108,548 English strings decoded as in FsLocalizationPlugin (histogram chunk plus string chunk with magic 0x00039000).

FrostyCmd scan-string-usage over Common/UI, Common/GameSetup and Common/Hardware/Weapons (70,678 EBX assets, level assets skipped, 536 unreadable): 63 of 64 weapon name ids found, all in UIWeaponAbilityMetaData assets.

Common/UI/MetaData/UIWeaponAbilityMetaData and Common/UI/Static/Metadata/S1-S4 UIWeaponAbilityMetaData_*: each Class_593f6146 weapon record links package images (T_UI_<internal>_PKG), has a label Field_55aded8d, and points (Field_fd698f51) to a Class_fbe1d3bc object whose Field_3d34898a is the name string id.

String ids are djb2-style hashes of text keys with seed 0xFFFFFFFF: result = char + 33 * result for each character. Keys confirmed: ID_ABILITY_<internal> for 53 weapons, ID_ABILITY_MP5, ID_ABILITY_MSBSGROT, ID_WEAPON_EF88, ID_WEAPON_VSSM, ID_WEAPON_BREN3, ID_WEAPON_HTI.
sourceBuild: Installed game on 2026-09-13; bf6.exe dated 2026-09-05, same build as the 1.4.2.5 XML export
notes: All other 60 site names already equal the game names.
AK4D has two English strings with text AK4D (8F929007, B77F06A7); the metadata uses B77F06A7.
Internal name KSG (not on the site) is the KSG-12.
Extra metadata records SCAR-SC .300 BLK and MP7A2 SP SUPPRESSED are variants of SOR-300SC and PW7A2.
Screenshot folder names and historical records keep the old spellings.
